Sync batch: created wiki/data-sources/cryptodataapi-supply.md (new category page) covering /supply/float and /supply/unlocks in full (float_pct, supply_basis, locked_supply/locked_usd, dilution_overhang, next_unlock, unlock_coverage not_tracked caveat; cliff-only /supply/unlocks with pct_of_float, DefiLlama coverage caveat); registered on cryptodataapi.md's category map + related; updated token-unlocks.md's Getting the Data section to add both new endpoints alongside /event/calendar?type=unlock; documented the new mint event type (delta_usd, pct_of_supply, long/short bias, observed not scheduled) in cryptodataapi-regimes.md's Event Regime section. All fields verified against the live OpenAPI schema (SupplyFloatRow, SupplyUnlockItem, NextUnlock, EventCatalystModel) and live curl tests.

Sync batch: added /volume/scanner and /volume/scanner/{symbol} to cryptodataapi-hyperliquid.md's endpoint table with full field docs (volume_24h, avg_volume_30d/median_volume_30d, multiplier/multiplier_median, band enum, kBONK/kPEPE/kSHIB aliases); documented /hyperliquid/summary's 3 new fields (avg_volume_30d, volume_multiplier, volume_band); added a relative-volume-screening trading-applications bullet.
